title: Binance Accelerator Program - Product Manager AI Agent & Harness
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE. Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws About the Role We're building the core Agent capabilities and Skill ecosystem for Binance Agentic. We're looking for a Product Manager Intern with a strong interest in AI and Web3 to support Agent product design, the Harness evaluation framework, end-to-end task validation, and continuous iteration. As an intern, you'll work alongside our PM team to explore how AI Agents can solve real Web3 problems — gaining hands-on experience in product design, evaluation frameworks, and cross-functional delivery within a fast-moving crypto exchange environment.
